phase: G4A-2R Phase 1: collision/visual geometry separation and mesh coordinate convention

mesh_convention.method: raw STL bounds * mesh_scale vs MuJoCo compiled mesh vertices mapped back to the authored frame via mesh_pos/mesh_quat
mesh_convention.unused_mesh_note: imu_link_mesh (mesh id 8, 2824 vertices) is retained by the compiler but referenced by zero geoms; neither MuJoCo nor the browser renders it. Not a display defect; documented only.

fk_consistency.method: per-body world position/quaternion, MuJoCo data.xpos/xquat vs Three.js linkGroups matrixWorld mapped through mujocoRoot inverse

projection_consistency.method: base_link / grasp_tcp / target_cube projected through the MuJoCo free camera vs the browser's matched camera
